notes.title: Goalgetter World Cup Demo Update to Version 1.0.02
notes.content: The World Cup demo has received an update. We have reviewed the feedback and online videos and implemented some improvements. We look forward to more feedback, and hope you enjoy the demo.

notes.title: Character creation, training and matchday in the World Cup demo
notes.content:
Today we'll go into more detail about character creation, training and matchday in the World Cup demo of Goalgetter and have a few new screenshots for you.

[h2]1st character creation: [/h2]
🌟 Skill Points: You decide! Do you want to be the air-headed giant or the lightning-fast winger who skilfully avoids the offside trap?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/b07f965510dfd8d7e855a50cb9528630537fb15c.jpg[/img]

🔄 Character traits: Choose carefully! Every positive trait comes with a challenge. The leader on the field? Yes, but also stubborn. The creative game designer? Keep in mind, he tends to be selfish.
🌠 Special abilities: Choose two unique skills that can give your player the edge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/946fb3bc24a594dd8ae6a6532a2d67dbc412ef99.jpg[/img]

[h2]2nd Training: [/h2]
💪 Full throttle or strategy? Do you give it your all in training or save energy for the big game? Your decision could still prove important.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/59e1a6774fcfdfa5295016354c8fa31e7494ceb9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Matchday 3:[/h2]
📋 Lineup: Your coach will tell you if you start. No starting spot? Maybe you can call in a favor. Or settle for a spot on the bench or in the stands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/79063194fb5d7b02483fa1be2f2826051aa09d48.jpg[/img]

⚽Live ticker & tactics board: Follow the game live, analyze the tactics and interact with the coach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/48a81a191d1abe3ce7dd7d6a0b173d8941c5d257.jpg[/img]

🥅Game-changing moments: When the opportunity presents itself, YOU make the decision. Do you take the shot yourself or pass it? Your player's skills and the opposing goalkeeper's skills could make the difference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/26da25550304a025aeadc9d72ad1452bc056a042.jpg[/img]

The question is: Will your decisions, skills and strategies make the difference? Will you be the Goalgetter?

notes.title: This is what awaits you in the World Cup demo of Goalgetter!
notes.content:
[h2]Immerse yourself in the history of football:[/h2]
Revive two of the most memorable World Cups - the 1954 World Cup and the 2022 World Cup. Experience these championships from a whole new perspective and write your own football history.

[h2]Character editor:[/h2]
Your Identity: Create your own national player. From the appearance to the background - everything is in your hands.
Distribute skill points: Every player is unique! Distribute your points wisely between speed, technique, strength and many other skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/d88acd28bc8ad685dd4879a6978b82bb9c63d15a.jpg[/img]

[h2]National team menu:[/h2]
Squad overview: Who are your teammates? Find out everything about the strengths, weaknesses and characteristics of your fellow players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/a8027db8376ce1f0a8d2b65cfc166b7f83c99cb8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Squad hierarchy: [/h2]
Find out where you stand in the team hierarchy and work your way up.
Matches: When are the next games? Who are the opponents? Prepare strategically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/6ece571d2162582637542af1f4076b9f18238034.jpg[/img]

[h2]Calendar menu:[/h2]
All games at a glance: A clear, chronological overview of all upcoming games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/d46a838bca16fa80caac43616d189fea570c1b51.jpg[/img]

[h2]Trainer menu:[/h2]
Interactions: Communicate with your trainer. Influence his opinion of you through conversations, gifts, or other actions.
Opportunities to play: The better the relationship with the coach, the higher the likelihood of playing regularly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/921c439f97e3f8b2d8be1e4cf42e1c4cc4d54c96.jpg[/img]

[h2]Goal wall training:[/h2]
Skill Improvement: Use this feature to improve your skills. The better you train, the better you will be on the field.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/d5c7606a9aa9abf591bd6cd61e67709281e98d65.jpg[/img]

[h2]Game behavior:[/h2]
Tactical Choices: Choose how you want to behave in games. Do you take full risks or play safe to avoid injury?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/eb09e0c5ca4cd62046ce3541d89688e6dd24369f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Statistics:[/h2]
Data paradise: From the top scorers to the number of followers - you can find all kinds of statistics here. Perfect for those who want to delve deep into the details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/d75c34de8a332defacfca3076ac56110f630a04a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Casino:[/h2]
Gamble & Winnings: Get a taste of the casino where you can bet your money. But be careful, luck is fickle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/bb69cbafd802ede10ab29f0ada5474db468a6cf6.jpg[/img]

The World Cup demo offers a small insight into the extensive world of Goalgetter. Take advantage of this chance and [b]start your football career on October 9th! [/b]

notes.title: Kickstarter campaign for goalgetter is giving away DLC
notes.content:
[h1][b]Kickstarter campaign for goalgetter is giving away DLC[/b][/h1]

It’s been one week since the Kickstarter campaign to fund the production of the PC Game Goalgetter started, and so far we’ve reached 23% of our goal thanks to the support of 39 backers.

To give the campaign a further boost, we have revised the goals. Every backer from € 20 now gets all future DLC for free. This also applies retrospectively to the corresponding supporters. In addition, this also applies if the Kickstarter fails. Even then, the backers on our Kickstarter list will be able to get all the DLC for free from us.

notes.title: Club/National Team in Goalgetter
notes.content:
[h1][b]Club/National Team in Goalgetter[/b][/h1]

In Goalgetter, it will be important to play your way into the first eleven both in your own club and in the national team.
In order to have a constant overview of your own team, a click on the club pennant on your desktop will take you to the club details. 
In addition to various statistics and information about the next opponent, you can constantly view the lineup of your own club.
Clicking on the national flag on the desktop does the same. Here you get information about the upcoming and past tournaments, the test matches, the current squad and the lineup of the national team.

notes.title: Scoring scenes in Goalgetter
notes.content:
[h1][b]Scoring scenes in Goalgetter[/b][/h1]

In Goalgetter it will be crucial in the game to make the right decisions and have appropriate values in the skills. 
In addition, there is another component: When shooting at the goal, you can choose whether you want to give the ball a cut (outside instep, inside instep, lob, pike) in order to influence the trajectory of the ball accordingly. After that, there is an action insert, where you can determine the shot strength and accuracy in addition to the shot target by making the appropriate clicks.
There is an extra function in the game for training the controls.

notes.title: Tournaments in Goalgetter
notes.content:
Goalgetter offers three game modes: [b]real career[/b], [b]team selection[/b] and [b]historical tournament[/b]. In the historical tournament you can replay world championships and possibly world cup tournaments of the past. This mode has by far the shortest playing time, as you can only play the corresponding tournament with the team of your choice. Currently there are already two tournaments:
1.) the Desert World Cup 2022
2.) the Miracle of Bern World Cup 1954

notes.title: The newspaper in Goalgetter
notes.content:
[h1][b]The newspaper in Goalgetter[/b][/h1]


After it has been a bit quiet lately, we want to use the next few weeks to introduce you to new features in Goalgetter. The first one is the newspaper. The newspaper will be displayed in the game on demand after every league and cup matchday and is also available in the living room table at any time.
The 3 pages are interactively filled with the data of the last match and the last matchday. Thereby the own performance in the last match, as well as the performance of the
team and the situation in the league under the magnifying glass. Here we have a few exclusive screenshots for you:
